d: Patna sthit bhartiy janta parti (BJP) pradesh karyalay ke bahar aaj rashtriy janta dal (RJD) karyakartaon ne jordar pradarshan kiya. emaelsi chunav men dhandhli aur matdata suchi men garabri ka aarop lagate hue aarjedi samarthakon ne bhajpa daphtar ke thik bahar 'vot chori' ke gaganbhedi nare lagae. pulis ki maujudgi ke bich hue is pradarshan ka vidiyo soshal midiya par teji se vayral ho raha hai.
